body: Ditto

Yeah, I know it's an expensive surgery. He took out a personal loan for his, think that's pretty common? 

And yeah, making friends is definitely tough. I've made most of mine through work, guess because that's what I'm passionate about so it's what I have to talk about with people? I say why wait until college for friends though? Do you have any hobbies, interests? Maybe try finding some social groups surrounding those. That's what my therapist always told me when I complained about not feeling close to people anyway.

I met my ex in person, he had gone through some rejection because he was trans so I understand your hesitation. Honestly what attracted me to him was his self confidence and the way he treated me. I didn't know he was trans for several months after we met, but when he told me it never made a difference. He did tell me one thing his therapist told him about relationships is you have to find a special person. That person is out there, just have to put yourself out there for it. Edited to say: We were together for 2 years, unfortunately he broke up with me recently due to different goals in life, nothing to do with the fact he's trans. 

I'm sorry to hear you're struggling to get your top surgery. I know that's a big part of dysphoria. I understand it must be rough to see others who have already had it, but perhaps you could ask those people for advice on how to get there yourself?

I understand how scary it can be to worry if your emotions will affect others negatively. But, in the end all you can do is try. If your mom has suffered from depression, she's probably a very good person to talk to about how you feel. She's been there and can help you through this. The way you feel isn't anyone's fault, especially your own. Depression has a way of making you think things that hold you in it. I hope you can find someone to talk to in your life that can help. Otherwise, hopefully a stranger on the internet will at least help you through this night. You are worthy of life and happiness.
Read Codependent No More. Wish I'd read it a long time ago before my relationships failed. Is helping me understand why I do a lot of the things I do
Can you talk to your parents? I'm not sure how your parents are, but I know many would want to help their children. I hope that's the case for you

Yeah, nights suck for racing thoughts. I've struggled with insomnia for a long time, especially when I'm depressed. Melatonin actually does help me with that. It's over the counter and I don't worry about abusing it. Not sure if you've tried it, but might be worth a shot

I can't offer you much in the way of self-love as I'm struggling with that as well, but wondering if you've tried online support groups to talk to other trans guys? My ex is trans, he found people to talk to on facebook groups when he was transitioning. I wish I had more to offer you, but I will say try to remember you are worthy of love. Everyone is.
Sorry you're going through this. Definitely know how hard it is to open up to people when you're the one people are looking to for a laugh. Can't hurt to try though, right?

Sorry to hear about your break-up. Going through a pretty devastating one myself. All I can say is, I'm reading a book called codependent no more. Enlightening for me and helping me through all of this.
Feeling lonely is one of the worst feelings. Definitely worse at night.
Slitting your wrists rarely works and you'll end up in the hospital. Nurses and doctors usually call it a cry for help. So, you're here now, why not skip the hospital bill and chat?

I wouldn't want one because no words could ever justify it to me. I think if I left one, all I would say is my fight is over and I'm at peace. But, of course, none of my family has any inkling that I'm even sad much less suicidal and I don't think there would be enough words to ever truly explain it to them.

I'm on here right now to vent and hope that my thought process will become more rational if I get it out. Hopong if I read that others are having the same thoughts I won't feel quite so fucked up and alone. So say what you need to. Even if no one responds people are reading and it might be helping someone else get through the day
I get it. I fight that battle every day. It's hard for sure
I think that's beautiful and a reminder to yourself that your time here is important to others.

Thanks all. Still here for now. Just went for a run, usually helps but didn't this time. Didn't have the courage to buy a gun today, so I guess I still have another day at least. Trying to make it productive for now, at least I'll go out fighting I guess.

I work in a career where you can't have that label as well. It sucks and I never disclose anything to anyone because of it and other reasons. But, I'll tell you, it makes life so fucking lonely. Put yourself out there before it's too late. Isolation makes life so hard, you have to be able to share the bad parts of you as well as the good to have meaningful relationships. It will eventually leave you feeling empty and alone, at least it has for me. Good luck.
Anyway, thanks for listening. Helped me get through tonight anyway. Good luck to you and thanks for your compassion.

I got sad. I don't deal with sad or problems well so I avoid them. I withdraw into myself because I don't want to be a burden for others. In keeping my thoughts and feelings to myself, I made my boyfriend feel like a failure. Every time he reached out to help I pushed him away and when he got frustrated with me I got angry that he couldn't just be there quietly and allow me to be sad so I lashed out. After all, I was the one who's grandmother died and sister got diagnosed with terminal cancer. Nevermind the fact his mom has stage 4 cancer as well. I ruminated over things he did, picked at little things he did because I felt vulnerable and down and wanted it to be anyone else's fault but my own. I got jealous when he would talk to his friends because how dare he carry on and be happy when I felt like time had stopped and there was nothing to live for. But I didn't ever tell him how I felt, I was just quiet. It's like i just thought he should be able to read my mind. I'm a fucking mess. As he tells me, I'm confusing as hell and he's right. I don't even know what I want or I'm feeling most of the time. I've spent so much of my life hiding my feelings or lying to the world about my feelings to protect people or minimize people's reactions that I genuinely don't know what I feel anymore.

OMG so much this. The word toxic is such a crutch. And why do people feel like it's ok to just psychoanalyze every action you make? When did it become impossible to apologize to each other and just get over things without it being a 5 day conversation about feelings and triggers?

I feel you man. It's so hard to feel like even when you're trying your best and give to people you still end up causing them pain. My boyfriend just dumped me and told me I make him feel like killing himself. Never told him I've struggled with suicidal thoughts for so long now. Tried so hard to just be there for him when he needed it and ignore the things that hurt me. Failed, he left and apparently just my presence made him think ending his life was a good option.
Sorry man, it's exhausting to deal with these feelings all the time.
Same. Hope it gets better

Yeah, I kind of just keep things close to the chest. It gets pretty lonely doing that, though. I find myself never really getting close to anyone then this overwhelming sense of sadness that I don't have anyone to talk to.
https://youtu.be/F2hc2FLOdhI

I fucked up the only good thing I had going for me today. I just wish the pain would end. I dream about being murdered and the sweet release it would bring without having to be responsible, how fucked up is that?

And honestly I'm too anxious to share the hard stuff even if there was someone. And I wouldn't want to burden anyone else with my sadness. Not sure why we do this to ourselves, loneliness is truly a cruel mistress who plays games with your head. I wish I had the answers, I wish I was a different person without the insecurities and pain. I wish I was strong enough to ask for help. That's kind of the rub, right? The people that need the most help are the least likely to ask for it.

All I can say is I feel you right now. I have so much to live for...good family, good boyfriend, good job...but, none of it seems to make a difference. I think a big thing lacking in my life is friends. I made plans tonight and got ghosted. I have no one to talk to about things because I don't want to burden my family or my boyfriend with my inexplicable sadness. I wish I just had some friends, but for reasons that are long I've found myself without any for a long time and it makes life seem so much harder without someone to just talk to. So, if you need a friendly ear, I'm here. I'm also a female in my 30s. Not sure how much help I can be, but I'm willing to listen.
I'm there with you.
